slides.narration: Chapter 28: Is This Numerology? A fair question. When a framework produces numbers that match experiments, is it discovering truth or finding patterns in noise? The answer lies in the predictions it hasn't tested yet.

Numerology fits existing data — you can always find patterns after the fact. Science makes predictions that can be tested. This framework makes specific, falsifiable predictions: the neutrino mass sum, the gravitational wave ratio, the dark sector spectrum. If any are wrong, the framework dies. There are no knobs to adjust.
